root_cause: After round 1 the post-conditions is_max and is_first and the termination goal remain unproved: the invariants only bound the indices and say nothing about the values seen so far, and the loop has no variant.
rationale: Proof repair, second step: add the functional invariants - every element a[0..i) is <= a[best], and every element before best is strictly smaller (so best is the FIRST maximum) - and the loop variant n - i (non-negative, strictly decreasing). At loop exit i == n, which turns the invariants into the post-conditions. Still no change to the executable code.
